scope: Independent offline interpretation of recorded evidence; no hardware I/O by this audit

final_context_proof.limitation: A point-in-time queue snapshot. Earlier absent PID listings do not prove worker absence; :ctxs omits the currently executing context.

stored_payload_after_coldboots.scope: Code blob including NUL and zero import count; excludes eight-byte flash header. Header flags are not independently readable through command 130.

interpretation.explanation: With foc_offsets_cal_on_boot=1, native 6.02 initialization calls mcpwm_foc_dc_cal(false), which updates current and phase-voltage measurement offsets in the runtime motor configuration. GET_MCCONF serializes that runtime structure. The observed changes are confined to exactly these native-calibrated fields, consistent with automatic boot calibration, not a tune rewrite.
interpretation.limits: No instrumented function-call trace proves calibration execution. This is source-backed interpretation of matching field changes and the enabled flag. These stationary boot checks do not replace post-install driving tests.
